summary: Tested both backend and frontend for: (1) Dashboard Open Positions strip bug fix, (2) Risk:Reward ratio auto-calc feature + trailing-stop default, (3) light regression on scan_market caching changes. All PASSED via real login + live browser automation + real paper orders (created and fully closed a NIO position during testing). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (auto-trader settings sync, positions/orders GET, auto-trader/process + scanner/scan smoke tests). Frontend: placed a real paper buy (NIO, filled @ $5.09) via curl to seed a position, then verified via Playwright: (a) OpenPositionsPanel renders below AccountStrip with data-testid='open-positions-panel', row testid='open-position-row-NIO', (b) clicked 'open-position-sell-half-NIO' -> POST /api/orders {symbol:NIO,qty:3,side:sell} fired, qty correctly went 6->3 after reload, (c) clicked global 'open-positions-sell-all-button' -> POST /api/orders {qty:3,side:sell} fired, panel disappeared after reload (0 positions), (d) on Trading page, changing Stop input recalculated Target display automatically (Stop=2,RR=2 -> Target=4.0), changing R:R input recalculated Target (RR=3 -> Target=6.0) AND fired POST /api/auto-trader/settings {reward_risk_ratio:3}, (e) GET /api/auto-trader/status.strategy.reward_risk_ratio correctly reflected last-set value via pytest, (f) Stop Type Select defaulted to 'Trailing' on a fresh browser context with confirmed-null localStorage.stopType, (g) QuickTradePanel BUY on Dashboard sent stop_type:'trailing' in the POST /api/orders payload by default (order itself rejected by backend due to wide extended-hours spread on RUBI - expected/correct behavior per problem statement, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: OpenPositionsPanel.js: clean, self-contained component; sellAllPositions loops sequentially (not Promise.all) which is safer for order-rate-limit reasons but slightly slower for many positions - acceptable given typical position counts (<=5).

QuickTradePanel.js and Trading.js correctly share the same localStorage keys (stopType, riskRewardRatio, stopLossPct) so behavior is consistent across both entry points - good DRY pattern already in place.
Trading.js useEffect recomputing takeProfitPct from stopLossPct*riskRewardRatio is correctly scoped to [stopLossPct, riskRewardRatio] deps only - no infinite loop risk observed.
auto_trader_service.py update_settings() and check_entry_signals() correctly use self.reward_risk_ratio consistently; server.py status/settings endpoints correctly expose/accept reward_risk_ratio.

Minor observation (not a bug): Trading.js is very large (2380 lines) - could benefit from splitting trade-settings JSX into a separate component for maintainability, but out of scope for this session's changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scoped features verified (sell strip, R:R calc, trailing default)

seed_data_creation: Placed and fully sold a real paper NIO position (6 shares @ $5.09, sold in two steps: 3 via sell-half, 3 via global sell-all) purely to exercise the OpenPositionsPanel UI. Account now flat again (0 positions) post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 main features (sell strip bug fix, R:R ratio auto-calc, trailing-stop-default) confirmed working end-to-end with real network payloads captured via Playwright. Regression smoke test on scan_market caching (auto-trader/process, scanner/scan) also passed - no issues from the rate-limiter/connection-pool/scan_market changes observed. Account is flat (0 open positions) as of this test run. Market was open (pre-market extended hours) during testing, so real order placement was possible; note several symbols (AAPL, SPY, MSFT, NVDA, RUBI) were rejected by the backend's wide-spread guard during extended hours - this is expected/correct behavior, only NIO had a narrow enough spread to fill.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found this round.
